response.justification: Despite extensive experience, the candidate is overqualified and misaligned with the junior/mid-level entry requirement; their resume reflects senior/lead roles since 2014, with no indication of seeking a step-down or team-contributor position, and they lack explicit experience with PostgreSQL, Nest.js, React, or renewable energy domain — key requirements for this role.
strengths: Extensive full-stack TypeScript and Node.js experience across multiple domains
Proven ability to build and maintain scalable web platforms and APIs
Strong open-source contributions and technical teaching background
concerns: Senior-level title and experience far exceed junior/mid-level role expectations
No demonstrated experience with PostgreSQL, Nest.js, or React as required
German language proficiency is only basic, but high on-site presence in Berlin is required

key_factors.factor: Missing core tech stack (PostgreSQL, Nest.js, React)
